invariants.rationale: Instant time is typically required for versioned upsert operations and should not be null.
The input record list should not be null for upsert operations; an empty list is preferred over null.
A non-null engine context is necessary for processing and coordinating distributed writes.
The input records list might be empty (size 0) or not, but the reference itself should not be null.
Instant time is usually a non-empty string to meaningfully identify a commit or delta instant.
